create_dataset_instance: create an ATR2GoliathDataset instance with custom images and segmentations directory paths
load_data_list: load all image and segmentation path pairs from the ATR dataset directories into a data list
get_data_info: get a single sample's image and segmentation map converted to Goliath format by index
map_source_to_target: map ATR source segmentation class indices to Goliath target class indices using SOURCE_TO_TARGET_INDEX_MAPPING
review_class_mapping: review the SOURCE_CLASSES to TARGET_CLASSES mapping and SOURCE_TO_TARGET_MAPPING dictionary for label alignment
